synthesis: DEV-2651 collapses the Company Metrics grid from 16 compact cards to 12 by merging four pairs into one card each: the survivor keeps its key, cache namespace and headline; the absorbed card's figure becomes a ->description() line and its series a second dataset in the expanded chart. Three pairs put a ratio next to a count, so those three get a second right-hand Chart.js Y axis (operator decision, 2026-09-21); unique-scan-counts + scan-count are both counts and stay single-axis. The framing 'reuse the SharedHitStatsData dual-axis pattern pattern' understates the work in one important way, agreed by all four prep passes: NONE of the four surviving cards uses SharedHitStatsData — that trait is hit-card-only, written against HitStatsBatchQuery/HitPlateStatsBatchQuery. So the pattern has to be rebuilt as a new shared concern on the DashboardWidget seam, and this would be the codebase's first dual-Y-axis chart. Two further things the ticket does not anticipate turned up and were verified against the code: merging scan-count into the Pro-gated unique-scan-counts silently removes the total-scan figure from every non-Pro org, and two of the four merges zip together series bucketed in different timezones.

questions.q: Confirm the final 12-card order. The ticket's proposed table is row1 = Unique Scan Counts | Unique LPR Case Claims | LPR Repossessions | Total Repossessions; row2 = the four hit cards; row3 = Missed Opportunities | Scans Leaderboard | LPR Recovery Leaderboard | Staging Live Hit Leaderboard. All three test-pinned constraints hold under it.
questions.answer: Yes — the proposed 12-card order as written in the ticket.

questions.q: Should the merged RecoveryCounts be Pro-gated? It has no canViewCardData() override today and renders for every ADMIN/USER viewer; the ratio it absorbs reads ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery, measured in-repo at 60,738,996 rows / 2.44 GB peak / ~1.1s solo, which today runs only for the ~29 COMPANY_METRICS-entitled orgs. Ungated, that trigger population widens by >140x.
questions.answer: MIXED, resolved together with Q3. recovery-counts keeps its Total Repossessions headline visible to ALL orgs (as today); the ABSORBED 'N scans per repo' ratio (description line + second chart dataset) is Pro-gated. So the card is partially gated, not wholly.

questions.q: NOT IN THE TICKET — verified regression. ScanCount has no gate; UniqueScanCounts gates on COMPANY_METRICS (UniqueScanCounts.php:84-89). Merging scan-count into it means every non-Pro org LOSES the total-scan figure it can see today and gets a locked placeholder. Accept that regression, or keep the total visible ungated?
questions.answer: UNGATE the merged unique-scan-counts card. Remove its existing COMPANY_METRICS gate. All orgs see unique plates (headline) + 'N total scans' (description) + both chart series. Operator accepts giving away the previously Pro-only unique-plates figure, and accepts that this widens the tz=<viewer> ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery scan from ~29 orgs to every ADMIN/USER org. Cost was stated twice before the decision.

questions.q: Pull the recovery-totals batching work into this ticket? RecoveryCounts's headline counts recoveries via 13 Eloquent round trips while the absorbed ratio's denominator reads the batched RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery. RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery's own docblock says the two paths can disagree by a few rows within a TTL. Today that drift hides across two separate cards; after the merge both numbers sit on the SAME card, so a visible mismatch becomes possible.

questions.q: UniqueScansToLprRepossession has no UNAVAILABLE_VALUE / numeratorUnavailable degrade path (verified: zero occurrences, vs 6/9 and 4/14 in its two siblings) — on a numerator fetch failure it renders a fabricated ratio rather than '--'. questions.answer: Standardize the UNAVAILABLE_VALUE / numeratorUnavailable degrade path across all three ratio merges in the shared concern.

questions.q: Two of the four merges zip together series bucketed in DIFFERENT timezones: UniqueScanCounts uses ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery's sanitized bucketZone() while ScanCount uses the raw viewer timezone; RecoveryCounts buckets in viewer-tz Eloquent while UniqueScansToRepo buckets UTC. Putting two such series on one 13-month label array mislabels bars. Normalize both merges onto one bucketing convention as part of this ticket (the safe answer), or accept and document the residual?
questions.answer: Out of scope — the viewer-timezone follow-on owns the viewer-timezone shift and explicitly sequences behind DEV-2651. THIS ticket only guarantees that each merged card's TWO datasets bucket consistently WITH EACH OTHER, so the new chart is not internally inconsistent on day one. For recovery-counts, repo_date is a Date with no time axis and cannot be shifted; document the residual in the class docblock per the viewer-timezone follow-on AC-4.

questions.q: Does removing a card key strand persisted per-user toggle/expand state?
questions.answer: No. Dashboard::$expandedCard (app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php:37) is a plain Livewire property with no #[Url], session or DB persistence; it resets on every page load, and toggleCard()/expandedCardComponents() resolve an unknown key to null without crashing. Nothing to migrate.

questions.q: Do the four surviving cards use SharedHitStatsData, i.e. can the SharedHitStatsData dual-axis pattern pattern be reused directly?
questions.answer: No. All four extend DashboardWidget directly. SharedHitStatsData is hit-card-only, written against HitStatsBatchQuery/HitPlateStatsBatchQuery with a $hitWidgetMap keyed to the four hit cards. The pattern must be rebuilt as a new concern, not inherited.

questions.q: Where does the 'N total scans' figure come from for the merged unique-scan-counts card?
questions.answer: It must be ported from ScanCount's own ScanStatsBatchQuery path (past-months batch + Scan::hot() current month). It cannot be derived from UniqueScanCounts's existing data: ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery exposes only uniqExact(ocr) and has no count column (ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery.php:166-192).

questions.q: What is the exact seam for the second Y axis?
questions.answer: Pure PHP. The vendor chart-widget blade forwards getOptions()/getCachedData() to the Alpine chart component verbatim, and Filament's ChartWidget::getOptions() just returns $this->options. So: a getOptions() override per ratio survivor merging a scales.y1 entry into DashboardWidget's base $options, plus a yAxisID key on each dataset built in getData(). No JS or blade work.

notes: SIZING: this is ~40 files (12 app, ~20 PHPUnit, 8 e2e) and a new shared abstraction. Phase 3's sizing gate (>6 files or multiple distinct concerns) will fire. Raised in the Phase 2 interview rather than deferred, so the plan is not authored twice.

The CompanyMetricsOverview docblock's own row layout (L52-56) contradicts its own cards() array. DashboardCardExpansionTest.php:156-159 restates the real order correctly — use the test as ground truth when rewriting the docblock.

UniqueScanCounts's ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() namespace is LOAD-BEARING: UniqueScansLeaderboard's sparkline is a passive reader of the month keys it fills (CompanyMetricsOverview.php:69-73). The merge must add ScanCount's total as a second dataset without touching that namespace or those fetch methods.

What is genuinely common across the three absorbed ratio widgets: SERIES_ZONE='UTC', MIN_TTL_SECONDS=60, getCardRatio()/windowRatio()/ratio(), and a byte-identical fetchUniqueScansSeries() reading the SAME shared cache namespace and backoff marker. What DIFFERS: the denominator source, and the herd-guard shape — UniqueScansToLprRepossession uses HeldFlexibleCache, UniqueScansToCaseClaims privately duplicates it (the ticket's fix target), and UniqueScansToRepo deliberately uses neither.

okf/concepts/company-metrics-dashboard.md is stale on main independently of this ticket: it documents 16 cards and a 5-card gated allowlist where the code and DashboardCardVisibilityTest both have NINE gated cards. Do not trust it while designing. Correct the pre-existing drift and this ticket's change together, POST-merge.
Per the standing preference for minimal comments, the new trait should match HeldFlexibleCache's terse style rather than the heavily-narrated style of the three widgets being merged.
Tests must stub the query classes the way the existing *Test.php files already do (Counting* subclasses); never hit real ClickHouse. Run `composer format` (Pint) before finishing.
Phase 6 QA risk: the hardcoded clarity-prefix issue (ScanStatsBatchQuery hardcodes `clarity.`) will 500 the Company Metrics page under local ClickHouse QA. Expect to work around it, not fix it here.

DECIDED (operator 2026-09-21): recovery-counts needs PARTIAL gating — headline visible to all, absorbed ratio Pro-only. canViewCardData() is all-or-nothing today, so a finer-grained per-figure check is needed. New, small, but not covered by any existing pattern.

MEASURED, drives the Q2/Q3 split: ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() embeds ':tz={timezone}'. UniqueScanCounts keys at safeTimezone(viewer); UniqueScansToRepo keys at SERIES_ZONE='UTC'. They are therefore TWO cache entries (two scans) for any non-UTC viewer, not one. Ungating unique-scan-counts widens only the tz=<viewer> entry; gating the scans-per-repo ratio keeps the tz=UTC entry at ~29 orgs. After the viewer-timezone follow-on shifts SERIES_ZONE to the viewer zone the two keys collapse into one.
